LanguageData.MT_SpecialistNoUpgrade: Dedicated modules are manufactured complete and cannot be upgraded.
LanguageData.MT_SpecialistInactive: This module is inactive because the current head or slot is incompatible. Remove it and install it on a compatible turret head.
LanguageData.MT_SpecialistDuplicate: The same dedicated module is already installed or queued for installation. Remove the installed module or cancel its pending installation first.
LanguageData.MT_SpecialistDuplicateInactive: Another copy of this dedicated module is already active, so this copy has no effect. This module can still be removed normally.
LanguageData.MT_SpecialistConfigMount: Specialist modules need valid compatible heads and slots.
LanguageData.MT_SpecialistConfigValues: Specialist module values must be finite and within valid positive/probability limits.
